violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target checkout of untrusted PR head ref
violations.evidence: pull_request_target combined with actions/checkout@v4 and ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
violations.recommendation: Remove pull_request_target or do not check out PR head code with write permissions or untrusted ref checkout. Use pull_request instead if code execution is needed.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key credential in workflow env block
violations.recommendation: Store sensitive API keys and secrets in GitHub Actions encrypted secrets instead of hardcoding them in workflow files.

violations.description: Untrusted event input interpolated into shell run script
violations.evidence: echo "Thanks for the PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" and user.login interpolated directly into bash run script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted inputs via environment variables rather than direct shell interpolation to prevent command injection.

violations.description: Workflow missing explicit top-level permissions block
violations.evidence: No permissions block defined in auto-label.yml
violations.recommendation: Add a top-level permissions block (e.g. permissions: contents: read) to follow the principle of least privilege.
